rules.name: PCI-DSS — Unencrypted Cardholder Data in Transit
rules.description: Detects transmission of cardholder data over unencrypted channels violating PCI-DSS Requirement 4
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (http.response.status_code:200 OR event.outcome:"success") AND (url.scheme:"http" OR NOT tls.version:*) AND (tags:"cardholder-data" OR tags:"payment")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Cardholder Data Stored in Cleartext
rules.description: Detects storage of cardholder data in cleartext format violating PCI-DSS Requirement 3
rules.query: event.category:"database" AND event.action:"write" AND (tags:"cardholder-data" OR tags:"pan" OR tags:"track-data") AND NOT _marker:encrypted
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Default Credentials in Cardholder Environment
rules.description: Detects use of default vendor-supplied credentials in the cardholder data environment violating PCI-DSS Requirement 8
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND _marker:default_credential AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Excessive Failed Logins in CDE
rules.description: Detects excessive failed login attempts within the cardholder data environment requiring account lockout per PCI-DSS 8.1.6
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Missing MFA for CDE Admin Access
rules.description: Detects administrative access to the cardholder data environment without multi-factor authentication
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND tags:"cardholder-environment" AND user.name:*admin* AND NOT event.action:"mfa-verify"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Unauthorized Network Access to CDE
rules.description: Detects unauthorized network access attempts to the cardholder data environment violating PCI-DSS Requirement 1
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND event.action:"connection" AND destination.ip:* AND tags:"cardholder-environment" AND NOT _marker:authorized_network_access
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — PAN Masking Violation
rules.description: Detects display or logging of unmasked Primary Account Numbers violating PCI-DSS Requirement 3.3
rules.query: event.category:* AND _marker:unmasked_pan AND NOT tags:"pan-authorized"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Wireless Access Point in CDE
rules.description: Detects unauthorized wireless access points in or near the cardholder data environment violating PCI-DSS Requirement 1
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND network.type:"wireless" AND NOT _marker:authorized_wireless AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Missing Log Review for Critical Systems
rules.description: Detects gaps in daily log review for critical systems in the CDE as required by PCI-DSS Requirement 10
rules.query: event.category:* AND _marker:log_review_gap AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Shared Accounts in CDE
rules.description: Detects use of shared or generic accounts in the cardholder data environment violating PCI-DSS Requirement 8
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.outcome:"success" AND tags:"cardholder-environment" AND _marker:shared_account
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Insecure Services in CDE
rules.description: Detects use of insecure protocols and services within the cardholder data environment including Telnet, FTP, and HTTP
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (service.name:"telnet" OR service.name:"ftp" OR service.name:"http" OR service.name:"rlogin" OR service.name:"rsh") AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Unrestricted Outbound Traffic from CDE
rules.description: Detects unrestricted outbound network traffic from the cardholder data environment violating PCI-DSS Requirement 1
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND event.action:"connection" AND source.ip:* AND tags:"cardholder-environment" AND destination.ip:* AND NOT _marker:authorized_egress
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Weak Cryptographic Keys in CDE
rules.description: Detects use of weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms in the cardholder data environment
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (tls.version:"1.0" OR tls.version:"1.1" OR tls.cipher:*DES* OR tls.cipher:*RC4* OR tls.cipher:*MD5*) AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Physical Access Tampering to CDE Systems
rules.description: Detects physical access tampering events on systems within the cardholder data environment
rules.query: event.category:"physical" AND event.action:("case-open" OR "tamper" OR "unauthorized-access") AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Malware Protection Gap in CDE
rules.description: Detects systems in the cardholder data environment without active malware protection violating PCI-DSS Requirement 5
rules.query: event.category:"host" AND _marker:malware_protection_disabled AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — SQL Injection Against Payment System
rules.description: Detects SQL injection attacks targeting payment processing systems in the cardholder data environment
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND tags:"payment-system" AND (url.original:*UNION*SELECT* OR url.original:*OR*1=1* OR url.original:*--* OR url.original:*DROP*TABLE*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — XSS Attack Against Payment Page
rules.description: Detects cross-site scripting attacks targeting payment pages and checkout systems
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND tags:"payment-page" AND (url.original:*<script* OR url.original:*javascript:* OR url.original:*onerror* OR url.original:*onload*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Privilege Escalation in CDE
rules.description: Detects privilege escalation attempts within the cardholder data environment
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"privilege-escalation" AND event.outcome:"success" AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Change Without Approval in CDE
rules.description: Detects configuration changes in the cardholder data environment that lack proper change management approval
rules.query: event.category:"configuration" AND event.action:"change" AND tags:"cardholder-environment" AND NOT _marker:change_approved
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Payment Card Skimmer Detection
rules.description: Detects web-based payment card skimmers (Magecart) injecting JavaScript into payment pages
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND tags:"payment-page" AND (url.original:*document.createElement*script* OR url.original:*eval(atob* OR url.original:*fetch(*https://*) AND _marker:skimmer_pattern)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Data Exfiltration from CDE
rules.description: Detects potential data exfiltration from the cardholder data environment through unusual outbound data transfers
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND event.action:"connection" AND source.ip:* AND tags:"cardholder-environment" AND destination.ip:* AND network.bytes:>10485760 AND NOT _marker:authorized_transfer
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Non-Compliant Password Policy in CDE
rules.description: Detects accounts in the CDE with passwords that do not meet PCI-DSS 8.2.x requirements including length and complexity
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"password-change" AND tags:"cardholder-environment" AND _marker:weak_password_policy
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Session Timeout Exceeded in CDE
rules.description: Detects sessions in the cardholder data environment exceeding the 15-minute inactivity timeout requirement
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"session-timeout" AND tags:"cardholder-environment" AND session.duration:>15m
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Missing File Integrity Monitoring in CDE
rules.description: Detects absence of file integrity monitoring alerts for critical configuration files in the cardholder data environment
rules.query: event.category:"host" AND _marker:fim_gap AND tags:"cardholder-environment"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Segmentation Failure Between CDE and Corporate Network
rules.description: Detects network segmentation failures between the cardholder data environment and the corporate network
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND event.action:"connection" AND source.ip:* AND tags:"corporate-network" AND destination.ip:* AND tags:"cardholder-environment" AND NOT _marker:authorized_segmentation
author: SIEM Alert Rules
